eParkstation allows each site/owner to configure kWh, parking and blocking fees independently, so no operator-wide price is valid. Current AFIR public matching is materially incomplete (external audit sees only about 8% iSATT coverage via Eco-Movement/ChargePoint), therefore exhaustive tariff recovery cannot be guaranteed from Mobilithek today. Verified exact station/point tariffs remain rankable via public QR/aggregator evidence; unknown BNetzA sites stay visible and unpriced. The gap is treated as an upstream publication deficiency, not a Germany pipeline blocker, and should be rechecked automatically as AFIR coverage improves.

policy: Station-specific operators do not block the Germany pipeline unless no current price can be obtained at either operator or exact station/EVSE scope. Rank only verified exact scopes; keep unknown stations visible and unpriced. Upstream AFIR publication gaps are monitored and retried but do not justify fabricated fallback prices.
